get_config: get the default MD4 training config for FineWeb EDU dataset
sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep with small and medium model variants for MD4 training
create_config_md4_fewshot: create a config for training MD4 on FineWeb EDU with 12 layers and 12 attention heads
build_training_pipeline: build a training config for MD4 diffusion model with cosine noise schedule and 1M steps
test_config_sampling: test the MD4 config sampling settings with ancestral sampler and cosine grid
